title: Maa Beti
desc: Savitri, a wealthy woman who dies during childbirth. Her husband remarries Laxmi, who, influenced by her brother Raghunandan, mistreats Savitri’s children, Meenu and Khetan. The children run away, and years later, Laxmi's daughter, Chanda, discovers the truth about her half-siblings and their tragic past

title: Teri Payal Mere Geet
desc: Premi makes a living by selling poems to Benni and falls in love with a courtesan, Laila Jaan. However, he leaves her after finding the truth about her but tries to get back with her.

title: Hariyali Aur Rasta
desc: A man's marriage is fixed from his childhood, but he falls for another woman. Though he marries his elders' choice, the ill-fitting union is thrown into disarray when the man's old flame re-enters his life.

title: Kasak
desc: Divya, a young woman, loves Suraj, who dies an unfortunate and untimely death. She is soon forced to marry Vijay due to familial pressure but not long after demands that he divorce her.
